title: Action initiation is a functionally adequate self-deception

statements.text: From a third-person view all goal-representations are misrepresentations, since nothing in the physical world is intrinsically a goal state. Organisms solve the problem of self-motivation by hallucinating goals, integrating them as intrinsically valuable into the transparent levels of the self-model, so action initiation is a functionally adequate form of self-deception.

sources.quote: Action initiation is a functionally adequate form of self-deception
Biological organisms like ourselves solve the second problem by hallucinating goals.
